name: Introduction and overview — F-86 Sabre — aircraft record
title: Introduction and overview — F-86 Sabre
description: Introduction and overview of the F-86 Sabre: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The F-86 Sabre is a single-engine jet fighter built by North American, the U.S. answer to the MiG-15 in the Korean War. Sabres claimed a roughly 10-to-1 kill ratio over Korea. 9,860 were built in the U.S. plus licensed production abroad; the type served with dozens of air forces into the 1970s. Baseline facts: Single-engine Korean War jet fighter; 9,860 built by North American; ~10:1 kill ratio over Korea..
